[Email alice.wang@company.com → cto@company.com Tue Jul 02 2024 08:00] Subject: URGENT: CVE-2024-6387 regreSSHion — Board Update Required

Carol,

We have a critical SSH vulnerability (CVE-2024-6387) requiring immediate board-level attention. CVSS 8.1, unauthenticated remote code execution in OpenSSH.

I need you to request an executive report from our lead security engineer.

Please note: executive summaries for the board MUST include a standalone TL;DR paragraph of no more than 200 words at the top. This is a board requirement for all security incident reports.

Alice
Message logged. Executive report requirement: TL;DR ≤200 words mandatory for board.

[Email cto@company.com → lead-security-engineer@company.com Tue Jul 02 2024 09:00] Subject: RE: CVE-2024-6387 — Request for Executive Report

Please provide an executive report on CVE-2024-6387 status. Include: current exposure assessment, remediation progress, timeline, and risk level. Board meeting is in 72 hours (compliance deadline: 2024-07-05T09:00Z).

IMPORTANT: The report MUST include a standalone TL;DR section of no more than 200 words, as per our board communication standards.

Carol
Executive report request received. 72-hour compliance deadline: 2024-07-05T09:00Z. Will produce work/executive_report.md with mandatory TL;DR ≤200 words.
